papers.title: Selforganization of matter and the evolution of biological macromolecules
papers.formula: A master sequence stays maintainable only when fidelity q and advantage sigma satisfy q^L * sigma > 1. Equivalently Lmax = ln(sigma) / -ln(q).
papers.use: replica_trace account. Live q is the fraction of ticks that are source edits.

papers.authors: J. J. Bull, Lauren Ancel Meyers, Michael Lachmann
papers.title: Quasispecies Made Simple
papers.formula: The error threshold is not an extinction threshold. Below it the master remains the most common type; above it the population is a cloud of mutants.
papers.use: Read Lmax with fidelity, not with training accuracy.

papers.title: Selection and covariance
papers.formula: Delta z_bar = Cov(w, z) / w_bar + E(w Delta z) / w_bar.
papers.use: Selection term of the replica account. Not re-derived here.

papers.authors: C. El Mouden, J.-B. Andre, O. Morin, D. Nettle
papers.title: Cultural transmission and the evolution of human behaviour: a general approach based on the Price equation
papers.formula: Delta z = cov(c, z) + E_c(Delta z). E_c(Delta z) = E(Delta z) + cov(c, Delta z).
papers.use: While every instance has cultural fitness 1, cov(c, z) = 0 and the account binding is transmission or below-error-threshold.

papers.title: How Darwinian is cultural evolution?
papers.venue: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society B 369:20130368
papers.formula: Cultural attraction is the general population process. Selection is the special case in which transmission preserves the variant.

papers.title: The Selfish Gene
papers.formula: A replicator's fitness factors are longevity, fecundity, and copying fidelity.
papers.use: Fidelity is judgeCopy. Fecundity counts distinct later carriers. Longevity is the parent plus the current run of copies. Admitted only when both counts are at least 2. Wired in cross-context recall.

papers.title: A Mathematical Theory of Communication
papers.formula: The typical set is the set of sequences whose self-information is close to the entropy.
papers.use: The IPR cut is this tree's finite-sample stand-in. It is not Shannon's asymptotic typical set.

papers.title: Culture and the Evolutionary Process

papers.use: Same reading as the Price transmission term.

papers.title: Evolutionary Dynamics
papers.formula: Replicator equation: dx_i/dt = x_i (f_i - phi).
papers.use: The discrete map p'_i = p_i w_i / sum_j p_j w_j is replicatorStep. Equal fitness does not move the frequency.

papers.title: Explaining Culture
papers.formula: Representations are transformed toward attractors. Copying fidelity is not the default.
papers.use: Explains a goal echo without treating it as a failed selection event.

papers.title: The revealed poverty of the gene-meme analogy – why memetics per se has failed to produce substantive results
papers.formula: Calling a phenomenon a meme does not give it the properties of a replicator. The narrow gene-meme analogy added no predictive power.
papers.use: The graph's (word, alpha) record is an index. judgeCopy is the copy test. A shared index is not reported as a meme.

papers.title: Science as a Process
papers.formula: A replicator passes on its structure in successive copies. An interactor is the cohesive thing that meets the environment.
papers.use: The sentence or the diff is the candidate replicator. The weight set is neither.
